Competitive Intelligence · May 2026 Adobe Internal — Not for Distribution

Executive Summary

Adobe has free online PDF tools at adobe.com/acrobat/online.html and ranks for every major query — but never #1. The gap is not content or product: it is a single UX friction point (forced login before processing) that raises bounce rate, kills dwell time, and tells Google the page is lower quality than competitors who let anyone start immediately.
Gap 1 — Highest Impact
Login required before any tool use. Competitors: zero account required. Adobe bounce rate is structurally higher.
Fix: allow first use, gate on download
Gap 2 — UX
Search bar is the primary hero. iLovePDF shows 29 tile tools above the fold. Users scan visually — Adobe forces them to type.
Fix: tile-first layout, search secondary
Gap 3 — Labelling
No "Free" label on free tools. US users assume Adobe = paid only. Free tier is invisible to the highest-intent audience.
Fix: "Free forever" tag on each tile
Gap 4 — Distribution
No PLG badge on output PDFs. Competitors' outputs spread across the US as passive ads. Adobe's outputs are silent.
Fix: "Processed with Acrobat free tools" output footer

Section 3 — Action Plan · Prioritised by impact, with owners and success metrics

4 Priorities to Become #1

Ordered by impact. P0 and P1 alone recover the majority of the ranking gap.
P0
Remove Login Gate — Allow First Tool Use Without Account
Let visitors process a file before requiring sign-up. Gate on the download or the second use — not the entry.
Add "No account needed" subtext under each tool tile.
This is the single change most likely to move rankings — dwell time improves, bounce rate falls, Google re-scores the page.
Metric to move Tool page dwell time +40%
Bounce rate −25%
Compress/Merge rank: #2→#1
HIGH ENG 4–6 weeks · owner: Acrobat Web PM + eng · requires product decision on free trial funnel
P1
Tile-First Hub Redesign — Replace Search Bar Hero with 12-Tool Grid
Move search to secondary position. Lead with a 12-tile visual grid: Compress · Merge · Split · PDF→Word · Sign · OCR · Protect · Fill & Sign · PDF→JPG · Rotate · Unlock · Number Pages.
Add "Free" badge on free tools, "7-day trial" on premium tools.
Add US trust bar: "Works with Microsoft 365 · 5M+ companies · SOC 2 compliant · No software download."
Metric to move Tool click-through from hub +60%
US free tool activations +35%
Hub page time-on-page +50%

P2
SEO Content Pass — 400 Words Per Tool Page + FAQ Schema
Each individual tool page (compress, merge, split, etc.) needs a 400-word task-intent content block answering the exact query it ranks for.
Add FAQ schema: "How do I compress a PDF for free?" → Google uses this for AI Overviews.
Add "Related tools" cross-links between every tool page.
Add "Free PDF Tools" as a primary nav item on the global Acrobat nav.
Metric to move AI Overview citations: 0→5+ tools
Tool page organic CTR +20%
Internal pageviews to tools +30%
LOW 2–3 weeks · owner: SEO + content team · no eng required
P3
PLG Output Badge — Turn Every Processed PDF Into an Acquisition Touchpoint
Add a subtle "Processed with Adobe Acrobat free tools — try at adobe.com/acrobat/online" footer to output PDFs from free tools.
Each PDF shared with a colleague or client becomes a passive distribution ad — reaching exactly the US professional audience we want.
Canva does this with "Made with Canva." Notion does it. It works.
